mechanism: Minocycline may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing methadone plasma concentrations and risk of opioid toxicity; minocycline also has CNS depressant properties that may be additive with methadone.
action: Monitor for signs of methadone toxicity (sedation, respiratory depression, overdose); consider methadone dose adjustment if minocycline is initiated or discontinued; counsel on CNS depressant effects.
